annotations.title: YRUZ Promo Board Top Link Takeover

description: Take over the GLOBAL TOP LINK of the YRUZ Promo Board for 24 hours with your live listing. The price is the server minimum (current top price plus the increment), quoted exactly in the 402; a stale quote is refused before it settles. Price: 0.05 USDC per call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base or Solana, no account, no API key); invalid input is refused before payment and a failed run is never charged. Without a payment the tool returns the x402 PaymentRequired. How to call it: get_example {"tool":"promo_takeover_top_spot"}. Same tool over HTTP: https://yruz.one/api/promo/takeover

id.description: listing id returned by /api/promo/create, 16 characters (required), aliases listing, listing_id

token.description: owner_token returned by /api/promo/create, starts with yzp_ (required), alias owner_token
